content.question: What is the Innovation Cell?
content.answer: The Innovation Cell is a committee of Government Polytechnic Proddatur consisting of the Principal and faculty members from different departments.

content.question: Who is the Chairman of the Innovation Cell?
content.answer: P Gurumurthy Reddy, Principal of Government Polytechnic Proddatur, is the Chairman of the Innovation Cell.

content.question: Who is the Secretary of the Innovation Cell?
content.answer: P Rajesh, L/CME, is the Secretary of the Innovation Cell.

content.question: Who are the members of the Innovation Cell?
content.answer: The Innovation Cell includes P Gurumurthy Reddy as Chairman, P Rajesh as Secretary, and V Chandra Sekhar Reddy, S Siddeswar Reddy, S Narendra Kumar, Y Harish, and N Siva Krishna as Members.
